text: 64-beat window scored every 8 beats past beats . window called AF normalised RMSSD RR intervals exceeds 0.1. Policy B additionally abstains 5% window’s RR intervals implausible (outside 0.3 2 s). two policies one detector, written vignette; validated AF detector.
code: bt <- beats$time rr <- diff(bt) ends <- seq(64, length(rr), by = 8) stat <- t(vapply(ends, function(e) {   x <- rr[(e - 63):e]   c(nrmssd = sqrt(mean(diff(x)^2)) / mean(x),     implausible = mean(x < 0.3 | x > 2)) }, numeric(2))) resp_a <- ifelse(stat[, "nrmssd"] > 0.1, "positive", "negative") resp_b <- ifelse(stat[, "implausible"] > 0.05, "abstain", resp_a) T_end <- hea$n_samples / hea$fs pred <- rbind(   tl_from_windows("04015", "A", decided_at = bt[ends + 1], response = resp_a,                   until = max(bt)),   tl_from_windows("04015", "B", decided_at = bt[ends + 1], response = resp_b,                   reason = ifelse(resp_b == "abstain", "implausible RR", NA),                   until = max(bt))) obs <- data.frame(record = "04015", start = c(0, min(bt), max(bt)),                   end = c(min(bt), max(bt), T_end),                   status = c("unavailable", "available", "unavailable"),                   reason = c("beats not started", NA, "beat stream ended"))
